subject: Data Engineering
title: GDPR and Data Privacy
description: Learn GDPR and Data Privacy in one minute.

hook.text: In 2018, GDPR gave Europeans the right to have their personal data deleted. Data teams scrambled.

buildup.text: GDPR requires consent for data collection, purpose limitation, data minimization, and the right to erasure.

discovery.text: Engineers must track where personal data lives, how it flows, and how to delete it on request.

twist.text: Deleting one user's data from a distributed pipeline that spans 20 systems is an engineering nightmare.

climax.text: GDPR forced data engineering to evolve. Privacy is now an infrastructure concern, not just a legal one.

punchline.text: Privacy isn't a feature. It's a system design requirement.

quiz.question: What right does GDPR grant individuals regarding their data?
options: The right to have their personal data deleted
The right to sell their data
The right to access any company's database
